longDescription: Paste a JSON array of objects and instantly preview and download it as a CSV. Column headers are inferred from object keys. Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

seoDescription: Convert JSON arrays to CSV online. Paste your JSON, preview the table, and download the CSV. Free, private, runs in your browser.

faqs.question: What JSON structure does this support?
faqs.answer: The input must be a JSON array of objects, for example [{"name":"Alice","age":30}]. Each object becomes a row; the keys become column headers.

faqs.question: What if objects have different keys?
faqs.answer: All unique keys across all objects are used as column headers. Objects missing a key will produce an empty cell for that column.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can I convert CSV back to JSON?
faqs.answer: Not currently, but a CSV to JSON converter is on the roadmap.
